design_status: prospectively frozen before any v2 recovery; same archived fields/cases/targets as v1
scope: Controlled ring-conditioned observation-contract correction for preserved production measurement fields. No rendering, rerunning old traces, image replacement, automatic trace promotion, calibrated optics or physical accuracy claim.
upstream_policy: Retain every case/lane; no g means upstream_ineligible, never substitute another image. Initial primitive count is recorded, not an extra fit eligibility filter.
normal_policy: Longest initial observed LINE by frozen source-end distance. Its unit perpendicular is oriented so dot(n, observed arc_mid-observed arc_centre)<0, using the largest-radius observed ARC as sector witness. No true normal or true centre is supplied.

covariance_policy.moment: exactly roi_sigmas=8 and background_offset=0 record for this case
covariance_policy.arithmetic_symmetry: If maxabs(S-S.T)<=64*eps*maxabs(S), canonicalize (S+S.T)/2 and record raw/canonical/maxchange; otherwise refuse. Then Cholesky/SPD check; no eigenvalue clipping or indefinite repair.

observation_contract.common_sigma: max(captured scalar sigma, sqrt(lambda_max(canonical valid nominal roi_sigmas=8/background_offset=0 moment covariance))). If nominal moment covariance absent/invalid, common sigma is captured scalar only and that lane remains explicitly ineligible.
observation_contract.crop: ONE common crop per observed ring, reused for BOTH covariance lanes. Padding=ceil(max(16,8*common_sigma)); lower=floor(min ring coordinate)-padding; exclusive upper=ceil(max ring coordinate)+padding+1. Request must fit source; crop_edge refusal rather than clipping or padding search.
observation_contract.coordinate_contract: Measurement ring points already use geometric centres. Local integer crop indices query centre i+.5. Hcrop=[[1,0,-origin_x],[0,1,-origin_y],[0,0,1]] maps GLOBAL rectified-plane geometry into cropped observation coordinates. Fitted C remains GLOBAL, R unchanged. No extra half-pixel shift.
observation_contract.field: Byte-preserving immutable crop of saved g; no rerender, re-encoding, interpolation or additional smoothing.
observation_contract.background_material: Border median and polarity-directed robust extrema now come from the same ring-conditioned crop; dark material declared. Constant levels remain hypotheses, not physical plateau certification.
observation_contract.seed: Frozen65th-percentile circle support, centered Kasa circle and97th-percentile chord support policy from observed crop/normal only. Geometry bounds use common_sigma, not this lane Sigma. No source truth before heldout scoring; no truth widening.
observation_contract.selection: ONE identical40training/16heldout selection for both lanes:24edge+8high+8low;8edge+4high+4low heldout, unique/disjoint local integer indices. Same seed,bounds,H,crop bytes and observed values in both lanes.
observation_contract.sole_change_from_v1: Replace whole-field observation preparation by declared ring-conditioned crop and hold covariance-dependent preparation fixed between lanes. Fitting algorithm, source fields, upstream population, normal rule and targets remain unchanged.

scoring: Only after fit and heldout intensity scoring, read baseline true centre_mm=[30,30], case radius/fraction. Convert fitted pixels using captured ppm. No target relaxation. Heldout means use same declared model at disjoint fixed g pixels, not training cost.

controls.case_population: All six cases and two lanes retained, including minor-directional upstream refusal; no eligibility changes based on true shape or primitive count.
controls.controlled_covariance_lanes: Prepare once per case and assert exact same crop bytes/local training and heldout indices/values/H/global seed/bounds for both lanes; only Sigma changes.
controls.dirty_outside_crop: For every prepared field, replace ONLY source pixels outside requested crop by deterministic0/255 checkerboard. Preparing again must keep crop bytes, selections, H, seed and bounds exactly identical; ignore intentionally changed whole-source provenance hash.
controls.integer_translation: Paste SAME g into a larger constant-valued canvas at offset(+11,+7), shift observed ring and primitive c/mid/source_ends by that offset. Local crop bytes/indices/values stay exactly identical; crop origin/global seed/global C bounds shift(+11,+7), R/f/radius/f bounds unchanged within1e-8pixel arithmetic tolerance. No fit or rendering for this metamorphic control.
controls.independent_mean_frame: At the DATA-DERIVED seed and fixed sampled pixels, compare global integer queries with H=I against local crop queries with Hcrop, using the same global geometry and lane Sigma. Independently integrate the projected conic vertical slices with erfc/GL32 and64 via frozen finite-free-centre-v1 area oracle. Require numerical intensity differences<=2e-5 and independent32/64 delta<=1e-7; no quadrature certification.
controls.edge_refusal: Translate ring toward source edge without changing source field; requested full padded crop must refuse with crop_edge. No partial-crop repair.
controls.v1_comparison: Read all12 archived parsed v1 rows only, hash each parsed row, compare status/completion/targets/C/R/heldout and observation estimates for every keyed case/lane. Do not rerun or alter v1; keep every adverse outcome.

cli_contract: Required --output NEW_JSON checked before backend import/analysis; help/missing/existing/dangling-symlink refuse without fitting. Strict JSON saved and stdout identical. All12 case/lane records survive first actual fit failure; later rows execute. Source/input hashes before/after.
limits: The two supplied effective-covariance lanes are hypotheses; neither is calibrated optical PSF.
g includes actual rendering, decoding, estimated sheet map, sampling, float32 and .7 smoothing; Gaussian/constant-level adequacy is not guaranteed.
Moment covariance is data-derived and background-sensitive; no claim that its numerical SPD proves Gaussian optics.
Fixed supplied normal is not fitted. Local finite search and complete coarse grid do not certify all minima.
Data-derived ROI/boxes and all refusals/errors/unfinished flags are retained.
Only archived synthetic rendered measurement fields are exercised; this is not a new full-photo pipeline run or real-camera qualification.
Shared crop removes a known contaminated whole-field border hypothesis but does not guarantee correct background, Gaussian PSF, constant illumination, normal or globally unique geometry.
